social.title: Live Jazz Night at Jazz'd Tapas Bar
social.description: Duck into a basement tapas bar where a band works through big band, blues, and swing six nights a week.
social.bonus: Request a song from the band between sets.

social.title: Craft Cocktails at Myrtle & Rose Rooftop Garden
social.description: Settle into a lush rooftop garden lounge for handcrafted cocktails above the Plant Riverside District.
social.bonus: Make a toast to someone you just met.

social.title: Rooftop Happy Hour at Bar Julian
social.description: Trade rounds of Mediterranean-inspired cocktails 13 floors up with the whole riverfront skyline as backdrop.
social.bonus: Order the drink you can't pronounce.

social.title: Dueling Pianos Show at Savannah Smiles
social.description: Shout out requests and sing along as two pianists battle it out in a high-energy all-request show.
social.bonus: Submit a song request the pianists have never played.

social.title: Taproom Flight at Service Brewing Co.
social.description: Work through a tasting flight at a veteran-owned brewery known for its easy-drinking session beers.
social.bonus: Let the bartender pick your flight for you.

social.title: Pizza & People-Watching at Vinnie Van Go-Go's
social.description: Grab an oversized NYC-style slice at the City Market pizza spot everyone ends up at eventually.
social.bonus: Split a pie with someone you just met.

social.title: Game Night at Grayson Stadium with the Savannah Bananas
social.description: Watch the most theatrical show in baseball unfold at a century-old ballpark under the lights.
social.bonus: Catch a ball thrown by a player in a kilt.

social.title: Sunset Cocktails at The Grove
social.description: Grab a rooftop table over bustling City Market and work through a list of housemade cocktails.
social.bonus: Talk to a stranger at the bar before you order.

social.title: Saturday Night at City Market
social.description: Bar-hop through the courtyards and live music spilling out of City Market on a Saturday night.
social.bonus: Bar-hop to at least three spots.

social.title: Blues Night at Bay Street Blues
social.description: Squeeze into a no-frills dive bar for live blues, funk, and soul most nights of the week.
social.bonus: Sing along even if you don't know the words.

foodie.title: Chef's Tasting Menu at Husk Savannah
foodie.description: Taste a Lowcountry menu that rewrites itself daily around whatever local farmers just delivered.
foodie.bonus: Ask your server what's grown within 100 miles of your plate.

foodie.title: Family-Style Southern Feast at Mrs. Wilkes Dining Room
foodie.description: Share communal tables and a dozen passed platters of fried chicken and sides in a 1870s house.
foodie.bonus: Sit with strangers and pass every dish clockwise.

foodie.title: Sunday Brunch at The Collins Quarter
foodie.description: Claim a table at Savannah's busiest brunch room and work through the whole menu of Aussie-Southern mashups.
foodie.bonus: Order a bottomless mimosa and stay for the second round.

foodie.title: Scoop Flight at Leopold's Ice Cream
foodie.description: Sample scoops of a century-old recipe at the soda fountain that's been drawing lines since 1919.
foodie.bonus: Pick a flavor you've never heard of.

foodie.title: South African Sandwich at Zunzi's
foodie.description: Dig into an overstuffed Conquistador sandwich at the cult-favorite counter a block off Chippewa Square.
foodie.bonus: Order the Conquistador without checking the spice level first.

foodie.title: Prohibition-Era Cocktail Class at Congress Street Up
foodie.description: Shake, stir, and strain your way through Prohibition-era recipes inside a hidden 1920s speakeasy.
foodie.bonus: Invent a name for the cocktail you build.

foodie.title: Shrimp & Grits at B. Matthew's Eatery
foodie.description: Dig into a bowl of rich, buttery shrimp and grits at a Bay Street brunch institution.
foodie.bonus: Ask the table next to you what they're having.

foodie.title: She-Crab Soup at The Olde Pink House
foodie.description: Spoon through a bowl of she-crab soup in a candlelit 18th-century mansion turned tavern.
foodie.bonus: Ask to be seated in the tavern cellar.

foodie.title: Multi-Course Tasting Menu Dinner at The Grey
foodie.description: Settle into a restored 1938 Greyhound bus depot for a James Beard-caliber tasting menu.
foodie.bonus: Order the dish you can't pronounce.

foodie.title: Saturday Morning at Forsyth Farmers Market
foodie.description: Browse tables of local produce, baked goods, and flowers under the oaks at Forsyth Park.
foodie.bonus: Buy something from a vendor you've never tried.

foodie.title: Coffee & Pastry at Foxy Loxy Print Gallery
foodie.description: Sip locally roasted coffee in a plant-filled cafe and gallery tucked off Bull Street.
foodie.bonus: Sit in the back garden and talk to no one for 20 minutes.

chill.title: Golden Hour Stroll Through Bonaventure Cemetery
chill.description: Wander live-oak avenues and Victorian statuary as light slants gold over the Wilmington River.
chill.bonus: Find the Bird Girl statue's original resting spot.

chill.title: Picnic Under the Oaks in Forsyth Park
chill.description: Spread a blanket near the fountain and let the afternoon disappear under Spanish moss.
chill.bonus: Read one full chapter without checking your phone.

chill.title: Wander the Galleries at Telfair Academy
chill.description: Take in the South's first public art museum, from period rooms to American Impressionist paintings.
chill.bonus: Find the oldest painting in the building.

chill.title: Self-Guided Visit to the Cathedral of St. John the Baptist
chill.description: Step into soaring twin spires and stained glass at Savannah's grandest cathedral.
chill.bonus: Look up before you look anywhere else.

chill.title: Boardwalk Walk at Skidaway Island State Park
chill.description: Follow a raised boardwalk through maritime forest and salt marsh to a wildlife observation tower.
chill.bonus: Spot an alligator from the observation tower.

chill.title: Explore the Jepson Center for Contemporary Art
chill.description: Move through light-filled galleries of modern and contemporary work in Telfair Museums' newest building.
chill.bonus: Find the exhibit that makes zero sense to you and sit with it.

chill.title: Browse Contemporary Art at SCAD Museum of Art
chill.description: Move through rotating contemporary exhibitions inside a converted 19th-century railroad depot.
chill.bonus: Pick the piece you'd steal if you could.

chill.title: Guided Tour of Owens-Thomas House & Slave Quarters
chill.description: Step through a Regency mansion and its intact urban slave quarters, one of the earliest in the South.
chill.bonus: Find the indoor plumbing system older than you'd expect.

chill.title: Quiet Afternoon at Tybee Island Beach
chill.description: Stretch out on the sand and let the tide and the salt air do all the work.
chill.bonus: Walk the shoreline until you find a full sand dollar.

chill.title: Evening Dinner Cruise on the Savannah Riverboat
chill.description: Glide down the Savannah River on a paddlewheel boat with a buffet dinner and live band on deck.
chill.bonus: Dance to at least one song from the onboard band.

chill.title: Sunset Cocktails at Rocks on the Roof
chill.description: Sip a cocktail on a maritime-themed rooftop as the sun drops behind the river and the bridge.
chill.bonus: Watch the sun drop behind the Talmadge Bridge.

chill.title: Coffee & People-Watching at The Sentient Bean
chill.description: Nurse a locally roasted coffee on the porch of Forsyth Park's favorite indie cafe.
chill.bonus: Strike up a conversation with the person next to you.

adventure.title: Fort Pulaski National Monument Exploration
adventure.description: Climb the ramparts of a Civil War fort still scarred by the cannon fire that made it obsolete.
adventure.bonus: Find the cannonball still lodged in the fort wall.

adventure.title: Tennis Match at Daffin Park Courts
adventure.description: Book a public court and knock a ball around under the oaks at Daffin Park.
adventure.bonus: Play a set against someone you just met.

adventure.title: Bike the Avenue of Oaks at Wormsloe Historic Site
adventure.description: Pedal a mile and a half beneath a tunnel of live oaks dripping with Spanish moss.
adventure.bonus: Count the oaks until you lose track.

adventure.title: Escape Room at The Escape Company
adventure.description: Crack Prohibition-era puzzles against the clock inside a speakeasy-themed lockup.
adventure.bonus: Solve the final puzzle without asking for a hint.

adventure.title: Vinyasa Flow Class at Savannah Yoga Center
adventure.description: Move through a sweaty vinyasa sequence at one of Savannah's longest-running yoga studios.
adventure.bonus: Hold the last pose ten seconds longer than you want to.

adventure.title: Ride the Savannah Belles Ferry Across the River
adventure.description: Cross the Savannah River for free on a passenger ferry with a skyline view thrown in.
adventure.bonus: Strike up a conversation with a fellow rider before you dock.

adventure.title: Dolphin-Watching Cruise with Captain Derek's Dolphin Adventure
adventure.description: Cruise the tidal creeks off Tybee as bottlenose dolphins surface and play alongside the boat.
adventure.bonus: Name the first dolphin you spot.

adventure.title: Round of Golf at Bacon Park Golf Course
adventure.description: Walk 18 holes on Savannah's historic public course, live oaks and all.
adventure.bonus: Play your worst hole as if it's your best.

adventure.title: Guided Paddleboard Tour with East Coast Paddleboarding
adventure.description: Balance out onto calm coastal water for a guided stand-up paddleboard tour around Tybee's creeks.
adventure.bonus: Stay upright through your first wake crossing.

adventure.title: Disc Golf Round at Daffin Park
adventure.description: Throw a round on the disc golf course tucked into one of Savannah's oldest city parks.
adventure.bonus: Play a hole left-handed.

adventure.title: Surf Lesson with Tybee Surf Lessons
adventure.description: Catch your first waves off North Beach with a patient instructor and a board built for beginners.
adventure.bonus: Stand up on your first wave, or your tenth.

adventure.title: Bouldering Session at Savannah Climbing Coop
adventure.description: Chalk up and work through a wall of bouldering problems at Savannah's community climbing gym.
adventure.bonus: Send a route you'd normally skip.

adventure.title: Wildlife Drive Through the Savannah National Wildlife Refuge
adventure.description: Roll past freshwater impoundments where alligators, herons, and eagles hide in plain sight.
adventure.bonus: Spot an alligator sunning on the bank.

adventure.title: Full-Day Outback Boat & Kayak Adventure with Outside Savannah
adventure.description: Motor down the Savannah River then paddle the marsh creeks around Daufuskie Island in one guided push.
adventure.bonus: Spot an alligator before your guide does.

adventure.title: Ghost Tour Through Colonial Park Cemetery
adventure.description: Wind through moss-draped headstones after dark as a guide unearths the graveyard's darkest true stories.
adventure.bonus: Ask your guide for the story they leave out of the brochure.

adventure.title: Group Sunset Run with Fleet Feet Running Club Savannah
adventure.description: Join a free weekly group run that loops through Savannah's historic squares at an easy, social pace.
adventure.bonus: Introduce yourself to someone before the run starts.

adventure.title: Kayak Expedition to Little Tybee Island
adventure.description: Paddle through winding tidal creeks to a wild, undeveloped barrier island reachable only by water.
adventure.bonus: Find the wildest, least-touched beach you've ever stood on.

adventure.title: SUP Yoga on the Marsh with Savannah Canoe and Kayak
adventure.description: Balance through sun salutations on a paddleboard drifting over calm marsh water.
adventure.bonus: Hold the hardest pose without falling in.

adventure.title: Trail Hike Through Skidaway Island State Park's Maritime Forest
adventure.description: Cover the park's full network of forest and marsh-edge trails in one unhurried loop.
adventure.bonus: Spot a bird you can't name and look it up later.

adventure.title: Segway History Tour of the Historic District
adventure.description: Glide silently past two centuries of architecture while a guide narrates Savannah's founding scandals.
adventure.bonus: Wave at every trolley tour you roll past.

adventure.title: Deep-Sea Fishing Charter with Miss Judy Charters
adventure.description: Head offshore on a boat run by Savannah's most legendary fishing family in search of the day's catch.
adventure.bonus: Reel in the biggest fish on the boat, or the smallest.
